text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa...!!
choice_data_list:
(What a breathtaking burst of speed, just 
like before...!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—A ferocious finishing kick flashed across 
the turf. 
With that alone, Daring Tact... 
captivated the hearts of everyone in an 
instant!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
............?!?!?! 
W-What on earth was that kick...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a second, 
she wasn't even on my radar! 
Who is that girl?! Uh, wait, umm...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Daring Tact... 
Wait, who is that?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
I ran true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...This is also the venue for the final 
leg 
of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(If so, then six months from now, the 
sight will surely be—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Woooooooooooooooooooo...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I will be the one to ignite that 
fervor.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: And to do that—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san! 
We can move forward now, can't we?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Toward the Triple Tiara races— 
First up, where it all begins: the Oka 
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her run in the Elfin Stakes 
convinced me. 
The first crown of the Triple Tiara, the 
Oka Sho... 
Daring Tact will undoubtedly claim victory 
there.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—You were able to get plane tickets? 
Then, you're really coming...!

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Of course we are—all the way to Hyogo!" 
"We even made a big banner~!" 
"We're bringing a ton of local souvenirs 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Yes, thank you so much. 
I'll be eagerly counting down the days!
choice_data_list: Please let me greet them as well!

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Trainer!" 
"Please take good care of Daring Tact!" 
"Give it your all, Daring Tact! Hang in 
there~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Right before all your eyes, 
I will claim... that first crown!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, Daring Tact is back! 
Welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is from the un-debuted members 
of 
our Tiara study group... A message of 
support!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow... Thank you so much! 
But why...?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'why'...? We're comrades, 
drawn together 
by the dazzling brilliance of the Triple 
Tiara, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
When one of us steps onto that dream stage 
ahead of the rest, 
of course we're gonna cheer you on! 
—Run your best for all of us, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Thank you. 
I will make sure every bit of your support 
carries me to victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Anticipation continued to build, whether 
anyone wanted it or not... 
The Oka Sho was right around the corner.

title: After the Elfin Stakes: A Shock in Bloom
